blocking_failures: behavior_in_tests: The tests cover deployment, schemas, basic lookup/history, errors, deduplication, generated reloads, and generation consistency, but do not cover all specified behavior, including detailed lookup behavior for unavailable timestamps, source-order tie behavior, rollover preservation beyond one fixture, and several incomplete-request/error cases.

valid_failure_modes: The verifier requires live network access for apt-get and downloading the uv installer, so otherwise-correct submissions can fail because of external network availability rather than task behavior.
